notes.decisionTsr: task-success-rate style single-scenario oracle check, similar to tau-bench pass@1/pass^k reliability framing
notes.resolutionAccuracy: conflict resolution / implicit inference accuracy over deterministic oracle pair rules

notes.confidenceCalibration: expected calibration error / reliability table over confidence_score or extracted confidence text

notes: decisionTsr is a single-scenario pass@1 oracle-state check, not an independent reasoning benchmark.
pass^k multi-seed reliability is intentionally deferred to v2.

Resolution accuracy is blocking only when scoreable coverage meets the configured threshold.
